qa_pairs.question: What component is covered under section 11 78 for emissions control?
Which engine section covers emissions control lambda oxygen sensor specifications?
What unit of measurement is used for the oxygen sensor torque specification?
What is the complete description for the component specified under code 1AZ?
qa_pairs.answer: Oxygen sensor and oxygen monitor sensor

qa_pairs.question: Does the 55 Nm torque specification apply to all vehicle types?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, it applies to all types as indicated in the Type column

qa_pairs.question: What emissions control component requires a 55 Nm torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: Lambda oxygen sensor (oxygen sensor and oxygen monitor sensor)
